name: qwen38-bw-fp4
description: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next FP4 measurement matrix against the 2x BW6000 vLLM container server.

estimate.basis: 2026-10-24 measure run against an already-loaded server

caveats: measure.sh measures a server that is already up; it does not start one. Run `benchctl run --recipe qwen38-bw-fp4` only after serve.sh reports ready.
Resources in the recipe are informational: llm/qwen38/config-bw.json is the source of truth for the Slurm job.
The FP4 checkpoint is a local site artifact; a stock vLLM cannot load its compressed NVFP4 scales, hence the pinned community container.
The first boot pays a 43-minute JIT/autotune; later starts reuse cache/qwen38.
The context ladder at 256K is prefill-dominated with 128-token answers; prefix-cache numbers use the paged probe, not this bench client.
